english.title: Company fail comply with s. 98 in respect of summons / giving notice of creditors' meeting
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a company registered in England and Wales which was subject to a creditors' voluntary winding up, without reasonable excuse failed to cause

(A)_[a meeting of its creditors to be summoned for a day not later than **(..SPECIFY LATEST DATE OF MEETING..), being the 14th day after the day on which there was to be held the company meeting at which the resolution for voluntary winding up was to be proposed]_
(B)_[the notices of the creditors' meeting to be sent to the creditors not less than 7 days before the day on which that meeting was to be held]_
(C)_[notice of the creditors' meeting to be advertised once in the Gazette]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 98(1A) and (6) of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
